title: Dog Riding Bicycle
description: A small corgi-like dog with large upright ears, tan and white fur, and a blue collar with a tag stands on the handlebars of a bicycle. Its front paws rest on the brown grips as it looks directly forward against a textured background.
prompt: A cute corgi dog with large pointed ears, tan and white fur, dark eyes and black nose stands balanced on a bicycle. Its front paws grip the brown handlebar grips while wearing a blue collar with a round metal tag. The dog looks straight at the viewer with perked ears against a textured painterly background in warm orange, tan and grey tones.
